messages:
marco: FYI - noticed a steady 10-20ms tail on a subset of hosts in rack r21 toward us-west-1 egress since ~01:10 UTC. P95 elevated but overall throughput steady. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/egress/r21

ops-bot: [Alert] egress-p95-elevated detected on rack r21 at 01:12 UTC. Linked runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/egress-noise

tay: Any correlation with large model loads or batch scheduling around that time?

marco: Not with batch. I ran `kubectl top pods -n tenant-17` and saw a flurry of short-lived exporter spikes from tenant-17-sidecar. CPU low but network tx bursts visible in tcptracer.

pei: Could be exporter flapping + NIC qdisc head-of-line. What's the tx backlog and NIC interrupts?

marco: Quick dump:
```
R21 host-7:
  tx_queue_len: 36
  p95_rtt_ms: 12.3
  interrupts_per_sec: 95k
  softirq_hogs: 5
  top_tcp_conn: tenant-17-sidecar:9090
```

sam: If this is a high-pps telemetry exporter it can starve small RPC flows and bump p95. We've seen similar when many sidecars poll synchronously.

tay: Options: 1) jitter exporter polling via sidecar config (best long term), 2) soft-throttle on tenant-17 egress (quick), 3) move tenant-17 to a prewarmed dedicated-slice in us-west-1 (expensive but isolated), 4) temporarily enable egress-policing qdisc per-tenant (kernel-level).

pei: I can patch jitter configs into the exporter helm chart and roll a canary. But that won't help immediately.

marco: For immediate relief I'm leaning to egress qdisc per-tenant on the host (tc classifying tenant traffic by cgroup). It's reversible and cheap vs spinning carveouts.

sam: Agree. Also add an irq-affinity spread to avoid single-core softirq spikes. Do both in sequence: irq-affinity then per-tenant policing if p95 doesn't drop.

ops-bot: Action queued: apply-irq-spread -> host-7, host-8, host-9. Will report back in 3m.

marco: IRQ spread applied. p95 down from 12.3 to 7.4, tx_queue_len -> 22. Still above baseline ~3ms.

pei: Applying tc egress shaping for cgroup tenant-17: 100mbit burst 10ms, drop threshold 80mbit. Command: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 20; tc class add ...` (ran via admin job)

ops-bot: egress-policing enabled for tenant-17 (01:29 UTC) on hosts [host-7, host-8, host-9].

marco: After policing p95 back to 3.2ms on hosts. Looks like policing + irq spread did it.
\
pei: Create follow-up tasks: - add jitter to exporter helm values (owner: pei) - add auto-attribution on alert pipeline to show top-sender-cgroup (owner: tay) - estimate cost/delta for dedicated-slice fallback (owner: sam)

marco: Sam please add cost numbers so support can weigh carving out a reserved slice if this becomes frequent. I put rough notes in INFRA-1301.

sam: Will do. Preliminary: reserved-slice for single tenant in us-west-1 ~2.4x cost of current shared egress due to headroom + replication. Exact depends on slice size.

tay: Also let's document the quick play in runbook: try irq spread -> 3m wait -> apply per-tenant policing -> escalate to carveout if still >5ms. I'll update the runbook.

ops-bot: Runbook updated by tay (01:45 UTC).

marco: Thank you team. Keeping monitors on for 45m and will follow up in INFRA-1301 with traces and tc configs. :white_check_mark:
